# db-migrations-reviewed

**HIGH.** Read every autogenerated file before applying it. Autogenerate sees a rename as a drop and an add. It also compares the database with loaded metadata, so a module's models missing from `env.py` become `drop_table`. Keep migrations static and reversible. Turn on Alembic's ruff `post_write_hooks` in `alembic.ini`, because generated files otherwise fail the gates.

Source: https://alembic.sqlalchemy.org/en/latest/autogenerate.html
